'''Umu'ro''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived circa during [[3630 BBY]]. Umu'ro owned several [[Starship/Legends|starship]] module [[Factory/Legends|factories]] and was looking to deal with new clients.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|No Competition}}</ref>
